planets.name: K2-26 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-26 with a 14.6-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: K2-26 b was found in 2016 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-26. Its orbit and size follow Schlieder et al. 2016's fit, the archive's default.
